title: texture color-format decode oracle (v0.1 — 4 linear 32-bit formats)
purpose: 8-cell 4x2 grid sampling a uniform 4x4 texture per cell. v0.1 covers 4 linear 32-bit-per-pixel formats (LU_IMAGE_A8R8G8B8 / X8R8G8B8 / A8B8G8R8 / B8G8R8A8) plus 4 cells that repeat A8R8G8B8 at additional cube-corner colors so the frame has 8 signal cells. Each cell's texture is filled with the format-specific byte encoding of the target color; the textured PS sampling produces the target color in the output framebuffer. The §4.7 spec calls for full 42-code coverage; v0.1 narrows to the linear 32-bit family to validate the new xbed_lib texture infrastructure (xbed_texture.{h,c} + xbed_load_textured_shaders + xbed_tex_{vs,ps}.{cg,inl}). Second wave will add: swizzled SZ_ formats (deferred to §4.8 swizzle-mipmap); packed 16-bit formats (R5G6B5, A1R5G5B5, A4R4G4B4) which need compare_overrides tolerance for sub-byte precision; DXT1/3/5 compressed formats; depth-as-texture formats; YUV LC_IMAGE_* formats. v0.1 catches channel-ordering bugs (cell 2 BLUE A8B8G8R8 would render RED if R↔B swap), alpha-vs-no-alpha confusion (X8R8G8B8 vs A8R8G8B8), and complete texture-stage binding failure (all 8 cells BLACK). The bind path uses xbed_texture_bind_stage0 which encodes the full stage-0 NV097 setup atomically (offset/format/address/control0/control1/filter/image_rect) + explicitly disables stages 1..3 to prevent cross-XBE state leakage.
